_comment: Keys starting with _ are commented out

keyboard._comment: USB HID remote control support. Enabled by default. keymap replaces the built-in map when present; keys may be KEY_* names or raw numeric codes. Run audiocontrol_input_devices --watch to discover codes.

services._metadata_removed: There is no services.metadata section any more, and adding one back does nothing. The player daemon holds no address for the metadata daemon: every connection across that seam is opened by the metadata side, which finds this daemon through services.core in its own configuration. See doc/communications.md.

core._comment: Where the metadata side reaches the player side: the now-playing WebSocket, the song-information push and the library sweep. Omitting this section means these defaults and not 'make no calls' - the metadata side always has a player daemon to talk to, which is why it is not symmetrical with the metadata section that used to sit above and no longer exists. With no url given the port is taken from services.webserver above, since that is the API this process is about to serve. 'library_poll_seconds' is accepted here and deliberately not set: libraries are discovered from the library_changed event, and the interval is only a backstop for one that was missed, so the built-in default (600) is the value to have. It used to be pinned at 30 here, which meant the shipped file overrode the interval rather than following it.

images._comment: Sizes the image endpoints offer via ?size=, and the subset the background job pre-generates. Both optional; these are the defaults. Each entry must be a non-negative integer no larger than u32::MAX; negative, non-integer, out-of-range, or duplicate entries are dropped with a warning, and if a key is present but not an array of numbers the default ladder is used, also with a warning. Pre-warm sizes outside the ladder are ignored. An empty prewarm_sizes turns pre-warming off.

genre_cleanup._comment: Genre cleanup configuration file. Maps genres to normalized forms and specifies which genres to ignore.

configurator._comment: HiFiBerry configurator API integration for system information

volume._comment: ALSA volume control configuration. Leave device and control_name empty for auto-detection via configurator API. Auto-detection uses hw:X format where X is the hardware index from the configurator API and selects the appropriate mixer control. If auto-detection fails and no manual values are provided, volume control will be disabled.

providers.name: example
providers._comment: localize is for an endpoint whose images are on a private network, or need a credential the client does not hold: the daemon fetches them with the headers above and serves them itself at /api/imagecache/external/<name>/. Leave it false for a publicly reachable provider, whose URLs already work. An endpoint can also send an image inline as base64 in the images entry's data field, which is always stored locally whatever localize says. max_image_bytes bounds a single image, inline or fetched; an inline image is capped near 7.5 MiB by the JSON body limit however this is set.
